description: Use this when the person asks when to cross, which hour or day is quiet, or how long it usually takes. Not for the wait right now: use get_border_wait. Answers a crossing's usual wait by hour, Monday to Sunday, for one direction and lane (the car lane by default), from the past weeks' counts, with the shortest hours named and tonight's shortest; or one day's hours when day is given.

crossing.description: a crossing's or airport's id as search_border_crossings shows it, or its name (Medyka, San Ysidro, Peace Bridge)

direction.description: the country the lane goes into: Poland, Ukraine, the United States

lane.description: cars (the default), trucks, coaches, walking, NEXUS, SENTRI, Ready Lane, FAST

name: get_usual_wait
title: Get the usual wait
